user.title: Procurement universe
user.description: Choose which TED notices define the radar. Strict mode uses defence buyers and the defence directive; broad mode also adds defence CPV codes.

data_description.market_preset: The buyer countries that make up the market. My country, peers, your own organisation, raw-data and watchlist countries are always fetched too.

countries.title: Custom market countries
countries.description: Select the buyer countries to include in the market.

my_country.title: My country
my_country.description: The country the radar is centred on: its awarded contract value, rank, share and trend are compared with every other country in the data. Any TED country can be chosen; it does not limit what is fetched.

data_description.selected_country: Stored as an ISO country code. Your Home Assistant country is pre-selected when TED publishes for it.

organisation.title: Selected organisation
organisation.description: Optionally track one public buyer (for example your own agency) as a separate device.

organisation_search.title: Find the organisation
organisation_search.description: Search TED for the buyer by country and name. The search is a prefix match on each word.

organisation_select.title: Choose the organisation
organisation_select.description: Candidates found in TED over the last 400 days, most active first.

peers.title: Peer comparison
peers.description: Compare competition metrics against a group of countries. My country is ranked within the market here too.

peer_countries.title: Custom peer countries
peer_countries.description: Select the countries that form the peer group.

categories.title: Pinned categories
categories.description: Each pinned strategic category gets its own device with count and value sensors.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.description: Fire a separate event for new notices that match all of the filters below. Leave everything empty to disable.

raw_data.title: Raw data countries
raw_data.description: Each selected country gets a device that lists the latest notices per kind (competitions, results, changes, …) and stored-notice breakdowns, without aggregation. Use the edp_radar.get_notices action for full lists.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TED Search API. Try again later.
error.no_matches: No buyer matched that search in the last 400 days.
error.invalid_selection: Please pick one of the candidates.
error.invalid_query: TED rejected the resulting query. Check the country selection.
